artifact_sha256_binding: The adjacent TERMINAL_ZONE_CONTRACT_V1.sha256 is the SHA-256 of these exact JSON bytes.

authority.source_kind: user-attached binding adopted by explicit read-and-act request

operator_fit.construction_time: Once per O02 invocation from the valid current topology, before O02 mutates any amount.
operator_fit.topology_visibility: Topology created later in O05/O06 becomes effective for uptake on the next update.

metric_graph.junctions: Valid reciprocal bonded endpoint ports form zero-length equivalence classes using the same relation and canonical keys as bonded-D transport.
metric_graph.segment_edges: Each segment is one undirected metric edge with physical weight L_i.
metric_graph.construction: Deterministic canonical graph independent of rank, tile, particle order, or bond-list order.

live_terminal_origins.TIP_bonds_at_one_site: The bonded site is basal and the opposite unbonded endpoint is the live terminal origin.
live_terminal_origins.isolated_TIP: Both endpoints are live terminal origins.
live_terminal_origins.free_non_TIP_endpoint: physically exposed but not a live-terminal origin
live_terminal_origins.component_without_origin: infinite terminal distance and zero terminal-zone uptake area; permitted after network evolution
live_terminal_origins.initial_area_matched_case: requires positive physical full and terminal areas

graph_distance.point_distance: d_i(s) = min(d_i1+s,d_i2+L_i-s) for s in [0,L_i] measured from site 1
properties: segments approached from both ends handled
physical area reached through multiple tips counted once

terminal_interval.snapping: Apply the frozen P11-style geometric snapping tolerance to distances within tolerance of ell.
terminal_interval.union_rule: The min prevents double counting for two-ended entry, branch ties, and multiple tips.

physical_surface.free_endpoint: An endpoint is exposed only when no bond attaches at that endpoint site.
physical_surface.terminal_cap_count: n_tipcap_i(ell) counts unbonded endpoints whose endpoint distance is <= ell
physical_surface.stored_area_guard: For every valid P15 segment, computed full physical area must match the stored area representation within the frozen local geometry comparator or hard-abort.

area_matched_TIP_010.initial_time: After initial topology validation and before the first uptake transaction.
area_matched_TIP_010.checkpoint: Serialize every frozen field; read and verify on restart; never recompute on restart.
area_matched_TIP_010.evolution: Keep M_area fixed as the network evolves; never rematch later.
area_matched_TIP_010.geometry_effect: M_area changes uptake intensity only and does not change reported fungal geometry.

representation_refinement.scope: collinear same-radius children with unchanged physical union and connectivity
required_invariants: graph distance at every physical point is unchanged
child eligible intervals exactly partition the parent interval
child lateral eligible areas sum to parent lateral eligible area
inserted bonded internal endpoints add no cap area
original external free caps are preserved
fixtures: terminal interval ending inside a segment
terminal intervals entering a segment from both ends

fail_closed_conditions: stored/computed full-area mismatch above frozen tolerance
nonfinite or nonpositive initial area-match operands
claim_boundary: RG-SW physical metric-graph uptake-area implementation contract only; not mentor approval, calibration, a BAS identity claim, biological validation of terminal lengths, or predictive validation.
